# PhytoDoctor AI

A plant-care web app: photograph a leaf, get an AI diagnosis, track plants over
time, and trade harvested produce in a marketplace. The diagnosis pipeline runs
on-device in the browser — photographs used for analysis are not uploaded for
inference. The app is offline-first: the plant collection lives in the
browser's local database and syncs to the server for cross-device accounts.

## Public pages

- [Landing and app entry](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/): first-time
  visitors see an overview of the garden dashboard before signing up.
- [Botanical Lab](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/lab): the leaf scanner,
  usable without an account (guest scans are rate-limited per day).
- [Help centre](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/help): help centre and FAQ.
- [Privacy policy](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/privacy): analysis stays
  on the device; account data is stored in Supabase Postgres.
- [Terms of service](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/terms).
- [Sign in / sign up](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/auth).

## Account-gated pages

- [Garden dashboard](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/): plants,
  weather-synchronised care, coach.
- [Clinic](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/clinic): diagnosis history and
  treatment plans.
- [Vault](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/vault): specimen vault with
  assessments.
- [Collection](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/collection): living specimen
  cards, rarity rankings, and growth badges.
- [Market](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/market): produce marketplace
  with a seed currency.
- [Library](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/library): field library of
  plant care plates.
- [Profile](https://phytodoctor-ai.onrender.com/profile): keeper profile and
  settings, including text-size and motion accessibility controls.

## Notes for automated agents

- The UI is a React SPA; routes are client-side. Rendering requires
  JavaScript.
- Health probe: /healthz (readiness, probes the database) and /healthz/live
  (liveness).
